title: First Hot Five session and Dreamland with Louis
summary: Louis wrote to Ory about recording together; Ory then worked Dreamland with him.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: What was the first record session in Chicago?

Hot Five. Hot Five. Hot Five. Louis wrote to me and told me he was going to leave Fletcher. He heard I was coming to Chicago, what I record with him, you know. Then I worked at Dreamland with Louis after that, you see. After the... Dutry got well and I was waiting for him.
